# Arguments script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## args.all

Gives you every variable of the running action at once, like user, message and rewardTitle.

**Gives back:** An object with every variable name and its value.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("args.all");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.args_all()
    ```

## args.get

Reads one variable of the running action, like the user who triggered it.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `name` | The variable name without % signs, like "user". |

**Gives back:** The value, or null when the action has no variable with that name.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("args.get", new { name = "user" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.args_get(name="user")
    ```

## args.set

Sets a variable of the running action. Later sub-actions can use it as %name%.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `name` | The variable name without % signs, like "winner". |
| `value` | `value` | The value to store: text, a number, true/false or a list. Leave it out to set it to empty (null). |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("args.set", new { name = "winner", value = "CoolViewer42" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.args_set(name="winner", value="CoolViewer42")
    ```
